limits: Repeated development photographs; post-hoc threshold comparison
Saved postclip cache is censored below box confidence .13
No robot or physical-operation accuracy measured
5/10 pixel tolerances are diagnostic, not user-approved requirements
No conclusion that confidence is a calibrated probability
Unmatched and reference-unavailable pairs are unverified for this supported-pair criterion, not proven physical errors
All four references annotate the same photographs
protocol.matching: Recompute original confidence-ordered same-class IoU>=.5 matcher using ONLY accepted predictions against ALL reference fronts
protocol.pair_rule: Both keypoints finite and inside original 1280x720 image, each confidence >= keypoint cutoff
protocol.pair_success: Reference-supported usable-pair success: assigned reference has both slots v=2, and both original-pixel distances <= tolerance
protocol.recall_denominator: All reference fronts with two v=2 slots, including missed or withheld fronts
protocol.success_fraction_denominator: All accepted pair outputs, including unmatched and unavailable-reference pairs
protocol.unavailable_interpretation: Unsupported relative to reference; no physical localization-error claim for absent coordinates

purpose: Post-hoc output-contract diagnostic, not an approved automatic-use gate
